{{Top|leg}}
'''Mag-particles''' were produced by a [[tight-beam emitter]] fitted with a [[pivar spinner]]. Mag-particles could disrupt the signals sent to a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] by its [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]], temporarily defeating it for around two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].
